headline: Ferguson was only top spender THREE times out of 39 transfer windows
body: In 27 years at United (and what was 39 transfer windows), Alex Ferguson was only top spender in THREE transfer windows!!! Three of 39. OUTSTANDING. Let's not forget that 9 of his treble winning squad were academy graduates. And he named at least one academy graduate in all 1,500 teams he named for Manchester United over 27 years. Ferguson wasn't a spender. He was a promoter of academy graduates. He was a one-man training academy. Let's also not forget that he won three league titles and a European Cup with Aberdeen, despite being the sixth highest spender of all clubs in Scotland between 1978-1986. Odd seeing posts comparing Pep and Sir Alex. There is no comparison.   submitted by   /u/LongYesterday6873 [link]   [comments]
